subject: Secure dev artifact index & rotation walkthrough for CAIQ review
messages:
From: Matt Lee <matt.lee@securebank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: SOC Audit Team <soc-audit@securebank.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ follow-up: secure development artifacts we still need

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the earlier submission. The assessor team ran a quick pass and has three follow-up asks so we can close the CAIQ/CA-03 and related secure dev controls:

1) A concise index (spreadsheet) that maps artifact names to the control they satisfy (e.g., code-review logs -> CC-PR-01).
2) Proof of key/keystore rotation for the last 6 months, with timestamps and the operator identity (or external KMS audit link).
3) CI pipeline config and a copy of the pipeline's enforcement rules (branch protection, PR gating config).

We prefer individual attachments for each item. If anything is sensitive, a Drive link with restricted access is fine. Also — would it be possible to arrange a short walkthrough (20–30 min) where someone from your engineering or security team can show the rotation runbook and the PR gating enforcement in CI? That would help speed sign-off.

Can you confirm ETA and what you'll attach?

Best,
Matt Lee
Senior IT Assessor
SecureBank Audit Team
[Attachment: none]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Matt Lee <matt.lee@securebank.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: secure development artifacts we still need

Matt — thanks for the clear list. We can get this to you by end of next week and coordinate a walkthrough. Quick notes: 

- I'll attach an artifact index as a CSV and include pointers to the CI config and the keystore rotation log.
- Jordan will supply the CI enforcement snippet and PR gating evidence; Marissa will include the code-review export and a zip of the review trail for the requested window.
- We prefer a recorded demo + short live Q&A to make scheduling simpler; happy to do both.

Tentative ETA: attachments and links by Thu 2027-07-22 COB PT. Walkthrough: Tue 2027-07-26 10:00 PT (30 min). Does that work for your team?

Attachments planned: artifact-index.csv, ci-pipeline.yml (redacted where secrets referenced), rotation-runbook-v2.pdf, code-review-trail-202701-202707.zip

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: artifact-index.csv]
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Matt Lee <matt.lee@securebank.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: secure development artifacts we still need

Adding the specifics so Matt has a clear mapping and the actual files where feasible. See below (I included short excerpts in the email and will upload full files to the Drive link):

- artifact-index.csv (attached): maps artifacts -> control IDs -> location. Example row: code-review-trail-202701-202707.zip, CC-PR-01;drive://folders/1A2b3C4dSecureBankCAIQ/code-review

- CI enforcement: ci-pipeline.yml (attached) plus branch protection PR rules live in repo settings (protected branch -> require PR reviews, require linear history). We included the enforcement snippet at the top of the YAML and a reference to the repo policy export: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4dSecureBankCAIQ/ci

- Keystore rotation: keystore-rotation-log-202704.pdf (attached) is our operator log for the April rotation. For KMS-level proof we point to our KMS audit export (redacted audit view) at the Drive link. Rotation runbook (rotation-runbook-v2.pdf) contains the operator steps and the approval checklist.

- Code review trail: code-review-trail-202701-202707.zip (attached) contains the PR export (author, reviewers, timestamps), and a short changelog manifest. Note that we've redacted developer emails to aliases where required by policy.

I'll upload remaining artifacts to the shared Drive and add the SOC team with Viewer access for the folder. Let me know if you need signed attestations for any item.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: ci-pipeline.yml, keystore-rotation-log-202704.pdf]
From: Matt Lee <matt.lee@securebank.com>

Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00

Kimberly/Jordan — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of additional asks before the walkthrough: 

- For the keystore rotation entries, can you provide operator identities (or operator IDs) for the April rotation row in the PDF? If that's sensitive, the KMS audit export with redacted fields plus a separate attest signed by an approver works.
- For the code-review trail zip, we need a short README that explains the export format and how reviewer approvals are represented (we often see CSVs that need mapping).
- Please also include the pipeline run IDs for three sample PRs (PR-1123, PR-1298, PR-1416) so we can correlate to CI logs.

Walkthrough time works for the team — 2027-07-26 10:00 PT is confirmed from our side. Could you share a calendar invite and the VC link?

Thanks,
Matt

Regards,
Kimberly Park
